messages:
tess: hey folks — pinging runtime, infra, and security for eyes on PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/52001. Brief: move LRU eviction into shared allocator, add an opt-in fallback routing policy in orch. Need runtime for allocator/kernel perf, platform for canary/merge slot, security on KMS usage. who can own approvals?

anil: I can take runtime review (allocator + kernel paths). Will run perf suite today. any specific scenarios you want measured?

tess: thanks @anil — perf focus on single-host high-concurrency (256 conns) and cold-start with kv-cache miss. PR touches runtime/allocator.cc, runtime/allocator.h, and orch/fallback-config.yaml. perf numbers are in PR description but full run would be great.

kevin: I can review orchestration/canary parts and schedule a merge window. prefer Thurs 03:00 UTC for canary. question: does fallback routing require schema changes to routes table?

tess: nope, fallback is policy-only, adds a new route tag but no schema migration. config diff: ```yaml
fallback_policies:
  - name: small-capacity
    route_tag: slow-path
```

anil: quick note: small mutex added to allocator fast-path; microbench shows <1% p99 delta. I'll validate on staging and post results. if perf looks bad we can gate behind a feature flag.

lena: security here — I can review KMS/HSM usage. @tess can you confirm we use envelope encryption and never log plaintext keys?

tess: yes envelope encryption. snippet from change: ```python
kms_client.encrypt(envelope_key, payload)
``` and config sets `kms_provider: "aws-kms"`. no raw keys in logs.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: CI started for PR #52001 — unit tests passed, integration tests queued.

kevin: :thumbsup: I'll claim canary ownership. tagging me as `canary-owner` in PR. Thurs 03:00 UTC merge slot works.

anil: I'll post runtime LGTM by EOD after staging perf run.

lena: security LGTM target: tomorrow 10:00 PT. will flag if there's anything blocking.

tess: perfect — plan: @anil posts perf results and runtime LGTM, @lena posts sec LGTM, @kevin runs canary Thurs 03:00 UTC. I'll add a short rollback plan to the PR (revert + disable fallback flag) once the LGTM chain is complete. Thanks everyone!
